# Vivapane

> An independent studio making Android apps. We build home screens that feel different: Aether Tiles, made of live tiles, and Living Icons, where your icons are little characters. No ads, no tracking, and your data stays on your phone.

Contact: aetherandroid75@gmail.com

## Apps

- [Aether Tiles](https://vivapane.com/aether-tiles/): Aether Tiles is a free Android home screen (launcher) that replaces icons with a grid of live tiles: clock, calendar, battery, weather, music and notifications, with no ads and no tracking. Status: Closed testing on Google Play.
- [Living Icons](https://vivapane.com/living-icons/): Living Icons Launcher is an Android home screen where your app icons are animated characters that react when a notification comes in. It works offline, with no ads and no analytics. Status: In development.
